hero.title: Drop by the shop and take in the aroma.
hero.lead: Our shop is on José Paulino Street in Campinas. Open the bottles, take your time with each aroma and talk to the people who distilled it — everything in the online catalog is on the shelves.
hero.photoAlt: Inside the Gota de Cura shop: wooden shelves with sprays, essential oils and soaps, the brand's sign on the wall and daylight coming through the window.
hero.captionTitle: Our shop on José Paulino Street
hero.caption: Everything that leaves the farm ends up here — and you can smell it before you take it home.

differentials.title: What sets us apart
differentials.lead: Gota de Cura is not a brand with a social cause attached. The cause is the reason it exists.

nonProfit.title: Non-profit
nonProfit.text: There is no owner or partner to pay. Every real from each sale goes to the charitable work of {morada}.

volunteers.title: Run by volunteers
volunteers.text: The people who plant, harvest, distill, bottle and serve you are volunteers, and they do it with a great deal of love and care.

care.title: Care at every step
care.text: From planting to bottling, everything happens at Chácara da Mãe Luzia. No step is outsourced, and there is no middleman between the garden bed and the bottle.

service.title: A personal touch
service.text: You talk to the people who distilled it. Questions about dilution, use or contraindications are answered by people who know the product and are always glad to help.

laudos.title: What's inside the bottle, in writing
laudos.lead: Chromatography is the lab test that separates and identifies every component of a mixture. We send our essential oils and hydrosols to the lab and publish the full report — not a summary.
laudos.body: It's the simplest way to check what came out of the still without having to take our word for it.

about.description: Gota de Cura was born in 2017 from a first batch of handmade soaps. Today it is a team of volunteers who grow, distill and bottle everything at Chácara da Mãe Luzia.
about.ogDescription: A team of volunteers who grow, distill and bottle everything at Chácara da Mãe Luzia. All income supports the charitable work of Morada Espírita Prof. Lairi Hans.
about.title: It started with a bar of soap
about.lead: Gota de Cura was born in 2017, on the initiative of our aromatherapist Marcelo Mattar. Today it is a large team of volunteers — and a catalog that keeps on growing.
about.story1: It all began with our first handmade soaps, made with fine vegetable oils — mostly extra-virgin olive oil — and enriched with rosemary and lavender essential oils. From the start they had something special: instead of water, organic tea tree hydrosol.
about.story2: New recipes followed, and new therapeutic aromas, always with quality essential oils. Over time, Marcelo began distilling the aromatic plants himself, by hand, to make our own essential oils and hydrosols.
about.story3: After the soaps came energizing sprays, bath salts, hydrosols, essential oils, tinctures and balms. We have never lost our purpose: to share the therapeutic and vibrational properties of plants through our products, with all income going to the charitable work of {morada}.
about.photoAlt: Vegetable beds planted in the farm's red soil, with palm trees in the background.
about.photoCaption: The garden beds at Chácara da Mãe Luzia, in Santo Antônio de Posse.
about.missionText: To offer well-being and quality of life through aromatherapy products, promoting physical, mental, emotional and spiritual balance.
about.visionText: To be a reference in aromatherapy products for their therapeutic and vibrational quality, with practices grounded in sustainability and respect for nature and for one another.

socialResponsibility.title: Social responsibility
socialResponsibility.text: All income from sales goes to the charitable work of Morada Espírita Prof. Lairi Hans in Campinas.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.text: Natural ingredients, spring water, natural fertilizer and clean energy. No pesticides in any of our beds.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Purity and therapeutic effectiveness proven by lab reports, not by promises.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: Clear information about what is in each product and how it was made.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.text: New recipes and processes, always tested before they join the catalog.

about.cta: Want to see up close how each drop is made?
